paraphrase: The ten perceptions: impermanence (of the aggregates), not-self (of the sense bases), unattractiveness (the thirty-one parts of the body), danger (the many diseases of the body), abandoning (of unwholesome thoughts), dispassion and cessation (nibbāna as the peaceful), non-delight in the whole world, impermanence in all formations, and mindfulness of breathing in sixteen steps; on hearing them Girimānanda's illness subsided.
